intent: Expose a source-preserving standalone website scraper as one callable library operation and a thin CLI over it, with versioned machine artifacts and a Markdown report derived from the same bundle.
implementation_shape: Reuse WebsiteToText.scan() with a no-op graph sink and explicit filesystem artifact runtime; do not call legacy execute() or a graph/runtime service.
Validate input keys, URLs, scope, extraction and resource values before calling WebsiteToText.scan(), so invalid invocation admits no fetch operation.
Serialize one versioned bundle to JSON and JSONL, then render Markdown exclusively from that bundle.
Map all-success to exit 0, a completed mixed batch to exit 2, and invocation/validation failure to exit 64.
